component.name: outPlayer
component.summary: High-performance media player powered by Qt 6 and libmpv

description.p: outPlayer is a modern, high-performance Linux desktop media player engineered for smooth, hardware-accelerated playback and exhaustive keyboard control. Built natively with Qt 6 and libmpv, it provides an uncompromising multimedia experience across all major video, audio, container, and streaming protocols.

ul.li: Hardware-accelerated decoding via VA-API, NVDEC, and Vulkan Video.
Exhaustive hotkey parity with 253 configurable actions and mouse gesture controls.
Sub-second seeking, frame-by-frame stepping, and A-B looping.
Advanced subtitle engine supporting styled ASS/SSA, SRT, WebVTT, SAMI, and PGS overlays.
Native audio passthrough bitstreaming for AC-3, E-AC-3, TrueHD, and DTS-HD audio.
Rich playlist management handling tens of thousands of items with instant filtering and search.
Comprehensive network stream playback covering HTTP/HTTPS, HLS, DASH, RTSP, and RTMP.
Modern dark UI with frameless window design, customizable controls, and minimal OSD overlays.

description.p: Production reliability, stability, and bug-fix release:

ul.li: Fixed libmpv end-of-file handling so manual track switching and stop commands do not skip tracks or emit false playback completion events.
Fixed libmpv aspect ratio reset (mapping auto/empty to "no") and 10-band audio equalizer filter graph (firequalizer via lavfi).
Fixed MPRIS2/system tray Play/Pause double-toggle and Play/Pause signal dispatch.
Fixed QShortcut duplicate collisions with Playlist-scoped commands and prevented single-key hotkeys from intercepting text input fields.
Fixed PlaylistDock chrome margin alignment under frameless TitleBar/ControlBar overlays and wired missing command handlers cleanly.
Synchronized Preferences settings keys (hwdec, deinterlace, aspect ratio, normalizer, speed, subtitle language) live with MpvEngine and hardened INI import validation.

description.p: Initial public release featuring comprehensive media playback parity, 253 hotkey mappings, frame-accurate seeking, and multi-format demuxing.
